description: Type annotations and interface definitions for various AOTI model runners and package loader in PyTorch, including classes and functions for tensor memory management, model execution, and constant buffer handling.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunner
classes.description: Protocol interface for AOTI model container runners with methods for execution and constant buffer management.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCpu
classes.description: CPU implementation of the AOTI model container runner.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerCuda
classes.description: CUDA implementation of the AOTI model container runner with overloads for initialization.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerXpu
classes.description: XPU implementation of the AOTI model container runner with overloads for initialization.

classes.name: AOTIModelContainerRunnerMps
classes.description: MPS (Metal Performance Shaders) implementation of the AOTI model container runner.

classes.name: AOTIModelPackageLoader
classes.description: Loader class for AOTI model packages, supporting loading constants and running models.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the model with given input tensors and optional stream handle.

methods.name: get_call_spec
methods.description: Returns a list of call specifications or signatures.

methods.name: get_constant_names_to_original_fqns
methods.description: Returns a mapping from constant names to their fully qualified original names.

methods.name: get_constant_names_to_dtypes
methods.description: Returns a mapping from constant names to data types.

methods.name: extract_constants_map
methods.description: Extracts a map of constants as tensors, possibly including inactive ones.

methods.name: update_constant_buffer
methods.description: Updates the constant buffer with a new set of constants.

methods.name: free_inactive_constant_buffer
methods.description: Frees resources associated with inactive constants.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the model package.

methods.name: boxed_run
methods.description: Runs the model with boxed inputs, returning boxed outputs.

methods.name: load_constants
methods.description: Loads constants into the model from a provided map.
